title: Beyond the Link: Assessing LLMs’ Ability to Classify Political Content Across Global Media

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM binary political content classifications (Political vs. Non-Political) from both URLs and full text against human-coded baselines, and diagnosing false positive rates by mapping news items onto a 1-10 ideological scale to reveal a systematic overclassification of centrist news.
Assessing cross-country and cross-lingual variation in model-human classification agreement by evaluating news articles from five different countries (France, Germany, Spain, UK, and the US).
